enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Pull the blanket over shoulders. Adjust pillow. Turn to the right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Roll onto back. Stretch legs. Curl up. Snore. Turn to the left side again. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Make toast. Spread butter. Boil water in kettle. Pour coffee. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry, running the washing machine and hanging clothes to dry
enriched_activities.desc: Gather laundry. Sort laundry. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle. Start machine. Wait. Remove clothes. Load dryer. Start dryer. Wait. Remove clothes. Hang clothes. Return.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put vacuum away. Pick up items from floor. Place items in storage. Wipe coffee table. Arrange cushions. Fluff pillows. Adjust curtains. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to supermarket. Enter. Pick up cart. Select vegetables. Select dairy. Select meat. Push to checkout. Unload. Pay. Bag groceries. Load into car. Return cart. Walk home.

Enter kitchen with grocery bags. Place bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Put away perishables. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Put away dry goods. Close cupboard. Wash hands. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take bite of food. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip water. Put down cup. Continue eating. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Pick up fork again. Take another bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip water. Put down fork. Push plate away. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Pick up glasses. Carry to sink. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses. Load silverware. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counters. Put cloth away. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust position. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Change channel. Get snack. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Jogging and doing outdoor exercise in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Change into workout clothes. Walk to park. Arrive at park. Stretch legs. Stretch arms. Start jogging. Jog around park. Increase speed. Run faster. Slow down to jog. Stop jogging. Walk to bench. Sit on bench. Drink water. Wipe sweat. Stand up. Do push-ups. Do sit-ups. Stretch again. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing into fresh clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply body wash. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clothes. Return to bathroom. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading health care journals and reviewing professional notes at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open journal. Read. Turn page. Take notes. Pick up pen. Write. Put down pen. Turn page. Highlight text. Close journal. Open notebook. Review notes. Close notebook. Turn off lamp. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Stir. Add sauce. Simmer. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Set table. Call to eat.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip water. Put down cup. Continue eating. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Pick up fork. Take another bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up cup. Sip water. Put down fork. Push plate away. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Stack dishes. Carry to sink. Turn on tap. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Drain sink. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counters. Wipe stove. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse websites. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Put down laptop. Change channel. Watch TV. Check phone. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Take out contact lenses. Put in case. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Get into bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read another page. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Fall asleep.
